pkgname=zigguro
pkgver=0.1.0
pkgrel=1
arch=('x86_64' 'aarch64')
depends=()
makedepends=('zig')
source=("$pkgname-$pkgver.tar.gz::https://example.com/v$pkgver.tar.gz")

build() {
  cd "$srcdir/$pkgname-$pkgver"
  zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast
}

package() {
  install -Dm755 zig-out/bin/zigguro "$pkgdir/usr/bin/zigguro"
}
